participant_id.Description: Participant label in this dataset (sub-01 .. sub-07).

source_code.Description: Participant code used in the original Dryad release (file names and the Figure 2 'subjnames' variable). It is a research pseudonym of the NIH program; it does not appear in the article.

figures.Description: Article figure(s) whose released data contain this participant.

microelectrode_array.Description: Whether the participant is one of the six participants with anterior temporal lobe microelectrode arrays (Figure 2 file lists exactly these six). n/a = not stated for this participant in the release.

age.Description: Age in years. Not released per participant (group: 34.8 +/- 4.7 years for the six MEA participants).

sex.Description: Not released per participant (group: 4 of the six MEA participants female).
